name: 65201 · Columbia, MO
findings: ZIP 65201 (Columbia) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 123 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65201 (Columbia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
